title: Mullet 2.0's FASTEST Run Yet! (Removed 500lbs Of Weight)
coverage: full transcript read (0:00-27:57); ~22:00 onward is Precision Turbo giveaway calls (64/66, 76, 88 sizes) with no car-build data
notes: Title says 500 lb removed; transcript says about 400 lb. Testing over two days just before 'the Snowbirds' event; track not named.

engine.notes: Ignition timing found ~10 deg off (EGTs very hot); crew guessed ~500 hp left on the table (claim)

ecu.tuner: Pete (remote tunes incl. new lockup tune)

weight_lb.notes: Same weight bias kept, but too light on rear tires; 40 lb added to rear after two spins
